decision: Restore original runtime. All tested alternatives have disabled-mouse baseline/candidate ratios below one; gains for enabled idle mice alone do not justify adoption. Short synthetic idle loops on shared host; this is rejection of an unsupported broadly beneficial change, not a precise whole-emulator slowdown.
